description: Canonical cross-configuration registry. Each entry is an external repo wired as a usable tool for the agent fleet. Consumed by tools/mcp/fleet-tools (MCP server), commands/tools/*.md, and the MR3/MRA fleet registries.

env.note: No admin rights: the python.org installer fails with 0x5 (access denied), so Python is provided by uv (user-scope, on L:). The WindowsApps 'python' shim is non-functional; always use a venv interpreter.

tools.name: vertex_orchestrator
tools.summary: Unified REST API that routes tasks to CrewAI (analysis), AutoGen (conversation) and Aider (edit) via Google Vertex AI. Hosts the recovery-overseer child service.
setup: uv pip install -e . + google-genai  (DONE into venv)
secrets: Google Cloud / Vertex AI service account
tools.notes: Core deps are just pydantic (+google-genai for the server); CrewAI/AutoGen/Aider are optional extras. Server uses stdlib http.server, no FastAPI.

tools.name: recovery-overseer
tools.summary: Node/Express dashboard that also exposes a Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) server plus Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Slides, Tasks, Keep, Drive) and a Spark/Gemini analytics engine.
setup: npm install  (DONE; esbuild binary rebuilt via npm rebuild)

tools.name: GenAIMindMapFlowBuilder
tools.summary: Modular FastAPI backend for AI-powered mind mapping with Neurite integration; routers for flows, qa, ingestion, sql and nodes. React+Vite frontend.
setup: backend/requirements_minimal.txt has a bad pin (starlette==1.3.1 conflicts with fastapi==0.104.1); installed with that line filtered -> starlette 0.27.0 (DONE)
tools.notes: Already agent-wired: GitHub-native Claude dispatch (.github/workflows/claude.yml), repository_dispatch 'claude-task', and a self-hosted 'genai-ollama-runner'.

tools.name: agent-lightning
tools.summary: Microsoft framework for training/optimizing AI agents; ships the 'agl' CLI (store, vllm, prometheus, agentops) and example FastMCP retrievers.
setup: uv pip install agentlightning  (DONE -> 1.0.2 from PyPI). NOTE: the repo's dev version (0.3.1) is Unix-only (gunicorn imports fcntl) and cannot import on Windows; use the PyPI build.

tools.name: paperclip-autonomous-agents
tools.summary: Paperclip ('paperclipai') - app + CLI to orchestrate AI agent teams, with pluggable adapters (claude-local, codex-local, cursor-cloud/local, gemini-local, grok-local, opencode-local, pi-local, openclaw-gateway).

cli.build: node build.mjs  (run in cli/; the repo's 'npm run build' appends 'chmod +x', which fails on Windows)

setup: DONE -> built and on PATH. Steps: (1) restore missing monorepo paths from upstream/master: scripts/cli-bundled-npm-dependencies.mjs, packages/shared, packages/db (its src/index.ts was absent), packages/plugins; (2) pnpm install --store-dir L:\pnpm-store (pnpm@9.15.4 monorepo); (3) add esbuild to root devDependencies; (4) add cli deps @paperclipai/shared + @paperclipai/hermes-paperclip-adapter (workspace:*) plus runtime externals zod, ws, three, postgres, @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp, @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp, @embedded-postgres/windows-x64; (5) build with 'node build.mjs' in cli/ -> cli/dist/index.js (~2.9MB). Shim: C:\Users\jayla\AppData\Roaming\npm\paperclipai(.cmd) -> node cli/dist/index.js.

NOTE: @paperclipai/server is intentionally external (published separately, dynamic import) and is not present in this fork; server-dependent commands (run/service) need it. Verified: 'paperclipai --version' -> 0.3.1 and the full --help command tree.
tools.notes: Repo also ships agent skills under .agents/skills (garden-inbox, paperclip-page, pr-gardening) and .claude/skills/design-guide + packages\adapters\hermes\skills\paperclip-task-bridge (both synced to agent-os\skills).

tools.name: memory-palace-with-brain
tools.summary: Next.js 14 'memory palace' knowledge app (Mongo/Mongoose, OpenAI, PostHog, Cloudinary). Ships two reusable agent skills.
setup: copy .env.example -> .env.local and fill secrets to actually run

tools.name: git-credential-manager-8e947aa1
tools.summary: Fork of Git Credential Manager (GCM) - secure credential helper for Git. Usable as a tool to manage/store git credentials without embedding tokens.
setup: needs .NET SDK to build (not verified present)
